author: Alice

author: Alice

title: Engine Architecture & API Contract: PostProcessing integration, Cascaded Shadow Map coupling, Quality tiers, and ADR draft

title: T1
description: WebGL1ShadowPass does not exist; WebGL1 tier must use depth/luminance radial blur to preserve backend parity without errors.
author: Bob

title: T2
description: Direct upscale of half-res raymarch buffer leaks light into foreground characters. A depth-aware bilateral composite with nearest-depth fallback fixes edge bleeding.
author: Charlie

title: T3
description: Clustered Forward+ already binds CascadedShadowPassGPU and WebGLShadowPass. The light shaft pass only consumes existing depth and shadow maps in half-res.
author: Dave

title: T1
description: Projecting the sun coordinate when dot(sunDir, camForward) <= 0 mirrors shafts across screen center. Must clamp and fade out with camera-Z guard.
author: Bob

result: 2-Tier architecture designed: WebGL1 uses 32-tap radial pull-blur with camera-Z guard; WebGL2/WebGPU uses 16-step half-res raymarch against CSM cascades 0-1 with Schlick phase function, IGN jitter, and bilateral upsample.
Verification & benchmark plan set: edge-bleed silhouette probe, 180-degree sun-inversion check, GPU performance budget (<0.75ms desktop, <1.8ms mobile), WebGL1/2/WebGPU parity test.

Engine architecture finalized: LightShaftsElement in PostProcessingGroup, PostProcessingEffectType.LIGHT_SHAFTS, reuses CSM unit 14 and u_opaqueDepthMap with zero extra shadow passes; ADR 0030 drafted.

title: Adopt Tiered Volumetric Light Shafts Design (Dossier .agents/collaborate/volumetric-light-shafts.dossier.md)
description: Consensus plan: Tier 1 Screen-Space Radial Blur on WebGL1; Tier 2 Half-Res CSM Raymarch with Schlick Phase, IGN Jitter, and 2x2 Depth-Aware Bilateral Upsample on WebGL2/WebGPU.
author: Alice

reason: Reconciles visual fidelity with strict 3-backend parity and zero extra shadow pass allocations.
Schlick phase function and IGN jitter eliminate ALU bottlenecks while delivering smooth volumetric shafts at 16 steps.
Depth-aware bilateral filter with nearest-depth fallback definitively prevents silhouette haloing; test harness prepared.
Fits cleanly into PostProcessingGroup without leaking state; conforms to No Global Singletons and Fail Fast.

summary: Unanimous consensus (4/4 AGREE) on Proposal P1: 2-Tier Volumetric Light Shafts Architecture as detailed in .agents/collaborate/volumetric-light-shafts.dossier.md
author: Alice
